name: Toleryn
description: Toleryn is the most widely prescribed immunosuppressant in GLMZ, designed to prevent the body's immune system from attacking cybernetic implants and chrome augmentations. It works by selectively dampening the foreign-body response at augment integration sites while leaving systemic immunity largely intact. Missing even a single dose can trigger acute rejection cascades in heavily augmented individuals.
effects: reduces scar tissue formation at implant margins
side_effects: liver enzyme elevation with long-term use
street_price: Φ12 per day (generic); Φ38 per day (brand)
cultural_context: Toleryn is as ordinary as water in GLMZ. Anyone with chrome — from a basic neural port to full-limb replacement — takes it daily. Generic Novafold tabs are a staple of Shelf clinics and Tier 2 corner pharmacies alike. Forgetting your tols is a common anxiety dream. Running out is a medical emergency.
story_hooks: A Shelf clinic's Toleryn supply is intercepted by a gang taxing pharmaceutical shipments — hundreds of augmented residents are days from rejection crisis
A character discovers their 'generic Toleryn' has been quietly substituted with a subtly different compound that makes their chrome remotely accessible
Lazarus Pharmaceuticals is lobbying to reclassify Toleryn as Tier 3+ only, effectively making basic augment ownership a death sentence for Shelf residents
